title: Spectroscopic and theoretical evidences for the surface binding of voglibose drug with DNA.
authors: Durga Priyadharshini, R; Ponkarpagam, S; Vennila, K N; Elango, Kuppanagounder P
journal: Spectrochimica acta. Part A, Molecular and biomolecular spectroscopy
one_liner_zh: 该文通过光谱实验与元动力学模拟研究小分子药物伏格列波糖与DNA的表面结合，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作体系外的药物-DNA互作，方法上含物理模拟但对象非TF-DNA，可借鉴其表面结合与MD模拟思路。
abstract: Binding of voglibose (VOG), an alpha glucosidase inhibitor, with CT-DNA has been investigated using various spectroscopic techniques including UV-Vis, fluorescence and circular dichroism (CD) coupled with relative viscosity. Isothermal titration calorimetric studies have been used to calculate the thermodynamic parameters such as DeltaH (0.0188 cal/mol), DeltaS (63.3 cal/mol/K) and DeltaG (-18.8 kcal/mol), which reveal that the binding is a spontaneous process and hydrophobic and H-bonding interactions play major roles in the binding process. Effect of ionic strength confirms the existence of hydrophobic interaction between VOG and CT-DNA. Competitive displacement assays with ethidium bromide (EB) and Hoechst 33258 suggest that VOG possibly binds on the surface of CT-DNA. Viscosity measurements also disclose that the binding could be mainly surface binding. Corroborating the experimental observations, metadynamics molecular simulation studies confirm that VOG binding on the surface of the DNA molecule through hydrophobic interactions and direct and water molecule mediated H-bonding.
abstract_zh: 采用多种光谱技术，包括紫外-可见光谱、荧光光谱和圆二色光谱（CD），结合相对粘度法，研究了α-葡萄糖苷酶抑制剂伏格列波糖（VOG）与CT-DNA的结合。等温滴定量热法用于计算热力学参数，如ΔH（0.0188 cal/mol）、ΔS（63.3 cal/mol/K）和ΔG（-18.8 kcal/mol），这些参数揭示结合是一个自发过程，且疏水作用和氢键相互作用在结合过程中起主要作用。离子强度效应证实了VOG与CT-DNA之间存在疏水相互作用。与溴化乙锭（EB）和Hoechst 33258的竞争性置换实验表明，VOG可能结合在CT-DNA表面。粘度测量也揭示结合可能主要是表面结合。与实验观察相印证，元动力学分子模拟研究确认VOG通过疏水相互作用以及直接和水分介导的氢键结合在DNA分子表面。
